testResults.name: hosted-recurring-deployment
testResults.result: The corrected workflow has not been pushed. A master push must prove input validation, OIDC login, resource-group validation and deployment with assignGithubDeployerRoles=false, immutable image verification, and public or private-ingress /health smoke behavior

environmentProtection.limitation: GitHub returned HTTP 422 because required reviewers are not supported for this private personal repository on its current plan

decisions: The one-time bootstrap is independent of storage, Key Vault, budgets, Container Apps, and image pullability so it can create the OIDC identity before recurring deployment.
The deployer receives no Owner role. Its conditioned RBAC administrator assignment permits only the four runtime data roles and only for the runtime managed identity.

Private ingress remains false. The workflow temporarily scales the API to one replica, requires all three HTTP /health probes to report a healthy provisioned revision, and restores scale-to-zero through an EXIT trap.
The workflow rejects a non-public GHCR package before Azure login or mutation because no registry credential is stored in Bicep or GitHub.
blockers: An administrator must explicitly accept the irreversible public visibility change for the personal-account GHCR package.
The local commits must be pushed to master before the required hosted deployment can run; repository policy requires explicit user authorization to push.
